verses.1: Do not judge, so that you will not be judged.
verses.2: For in that place you will be judged by judgment; and in that place your measurements will be measured.
verses.3: And how can you see the “stone” that is in your brother’s eye? How can you not understand what’s in his eye?
verses.4: How do you expect to be with your brother? I’ll pull out the eyebrow from your eye. And see if you can see something in your eye now.
verses.5: The deceiver first releases the eye from its socket. Then, at that moment, you should also release the eye from your brother’s socket.
verses.6: Do not give the holy animals to the pigs. Also, do not place your magicians in front of the pigs, so that they won’t be able to deceive you while you are still in their midst.
verses.7: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
verses.8: For every request made, one will be able to find what is desired, and it will be opened up for use.
verses.9: Who among you is such a person that his son would ask him for bread? Wouldn’t he give him some bread, surely?
verses.10: And he will also ask for fish. Will he not give them to him?
verses.11: If you, being evil people, know how to give good things to your children, then how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him for them.
verses.12: Therefore, always do whatever you desire that people should do for you. This is the law, and it’s also what the prophets have commanded.
verses.13: You entered through the narrow gate. The gate was wide and the path leading through it was spacious, leading towards destruction. Many people entered through that gate.
verses.14: Because the path leading to life is narrow and difficult, and few people can find it.
verses.15: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you dressed as sheep, but behind their mask are wolves that will steal from you.
verses.16: You can recognize them by their fruits. Do they actually pick up corms from plants, or do they collect them from other sources?
verses.17: In this way, every good tree bears good fruit; but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
verses.18: A good tree cannot produce bad fruits; nor can a bad tree produce good fruits.
verses.19: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.20: Therefore, you should recognize them from their fruits.
verses.21: Not everyone says this to me. Lord, you will come into the kingdom of heaven. But it’s those who carry out my Father’s will that will enter that kingdom.
verses.22: Many people will ask me about that day. Lord, we did not prophesy in the name of pigs, nor did we send demons in their name, and we also did not use many forces in their name.
verses.23: And at that time, I will confess to them that I never understood you at all. Let those who are involved in this dishonesty get away from me.
verses.24: Therefore, anyone who hears these words and acts upon them will be like a man who has built his house on rock.
verses.25: And the rain stopped, and the rivers flowed again, and the winds ceased to blow. They settled upon the rocks there. In fact, they didn’t fall at all; they remained firmly attached to the rocks.
verses.26: And anyone who hears these words from me and does not act upon them will be like a stupid man, who builds his house on sand.
verses.27: And it began to rain, and the rivers flowed, and the winds blew strongly. They rushed towards that house. It fell down, and its fall was very heavy.
verses.28: And it happened that when Jesus finished speaking these words, the crowd was astonished by his teachings.
verses.29: For he was teaching them that they had authority, and not like their officials.
